where: crates/blaze-scope/src/crate_scope.rs `Dep`, crates/blaze-scope/src/cells/lazy_deps.rs `LazyDep`; seen as resolve.rs `Names::shorter` failing to compile
what: A dependency solved on demand first held its growing scopes in a RefCell inside the `Dep::Lazy` it was read through. That made `Dep<'a>`, and so `Names<'a>`, invariant in 'a; `Names::shorter` (and six tests that borrow names) stopped compiling with 'lifetime may not live long enough', far from the change.
cost: one ask (about 10 minutes in the queue)
cause: interior mutability of 'a data inside a type `Names` needs covariant
whys: the miss sink and the growing state were one object; only the sink needs mutation
class: a RefCell/Cell of lifetime-carrying data inside a type that must be covariant
prevention: done: `LazyDep` is a frozen view per solve (its solves and scopes copied as references) and its sink a `&'a (dyn WantSink + 'a)`, a lifetime-free trait object; the driver owns the mutable state
annoyance: the runner's queue is 3-5 asks deep: a typo costs 5-20 minutes
workaround: read the error line and fix both shapes before asking again
